name: Abhishek Pratap Singh
title: Advocate
tagline: Disputes practitioner. Draftsman by discipline, engineer by method.
summary: Newly enrolled advocate with concentrated training in disputes, including arbitration, SEBI and SAT enforcement, PMLA defence, corporate insolvency, public procurement and constitutional writ practice, alongside independent work in civil recovery and real estate drafting. Drafting foundation across plaints, written statements, counter-claims, writ petitions, counter-affidavits, replies to Section 50 PMLA summons, cease-and-desist notices and commercial agreements. Pinpoint-verified research on SCC Online and Manupatra, sharpened by technology-assisted workflows for research and document preparation.

experience.where: Asraya Legal, Defence Colony, New Delhi
experience.intro: Concentrated litigation training across arbitration, securities enforcement, PMLA defence, corporate insolvency, public procurement, tax writs and real estate.

matters.text: Appeal against an order in execution of an arbitral award: jurisdictional contention under Section 42 built on Associated Contractors and BGS SGS Soma JV, with the adverse High Court authority identified and distinguished; the award tested against limitation precedents including Geo Miller and B&T AG.

Special leave petition for bail: ground-by-ground research map (Nanjappa, Neeraj Dutta, P. Chidambaram v. ED, Manish Sisodia v. ED), OCR-based pinpoint verification against reported judgments, List of Dates, and English translation of a Hindi chargesheet.

Proposed grounds of appeal against a SEBI final order involving fifteen noticees: per-noticee exposure grid grading liability and quantum, and a doctrinal defence drawn from Kanaiyalal, Balram Garg, Chintalapati and Kishore Ajmera.
Replies to summons in English and Hindi for two individuals, structured on a two-layer denial: no proceeds of crime in the client's hands, and absence of knowledge and mens rea under Section 3.
Counter-affidavit in a tender-disqualification writ against a public sector respondent, founded on two independent grounds drawn from the petitioner's own bid documents.
Writ research across six independent grounds, including an argument on the mischaracterisation of proceedings under Section 74.
Due diligence on a pending insolvency petition against a listed infrastructure company, assessing the reach of the Section 14 moratorium.
Reply to a contractor-debarment show-cause notice, with the natural-justice deficiency identified as the primary line of defence.
Proxy appearance in a broadcasting petition.
Summary suit strategy for debt recovery, structured on appropriation of payments under Section 60 of the Indian Contract Act, elected in place of a time-barred Section 138 NI Act route.
Vetting of a construction agreement for a Greater Noida property, with amendments addressing quantity variance, extra-work approval, liquidated damages and a bespoke arbitration clause.
Cease-and-desist and legal notices in a West Delhi title-and-possession dispute.
Statutory framework for a domestic dispute across protective, criminal and civil recovery remedies, with a strength and weakness matrix.

experience.when: Sep to Nov 2025 · Feb to Apr 2026
experience.intro: Assessment internship, extended as a call-back traineeship. Drafting and research across commercial, civil, property, MACT and consumer matters.

matters.text: First draft of a commercial suit for breach of a binding transfer agreement concerning a Discovered Small Field.
First draft of a cross-appeal; counter-affidavit in a civil recovery suit; rejoinder before a District Consumer Commission.
Preliminary note on the revocation of a gift deed of immovable property; grounds for a motor accident claims appeal.
Short-term rental service agreement; condonation of delay applications; ex parte evidence affidavits; electronic evidence certificates; statements of truth.

earlier: Internships during the LLB: Delhi High Court (chambers of HMJ Mini Pushkarna); chambers of Sr. Adv. Sanjay R. Hegde; Delhi Dispute Resolution Society; Aspire Legal, East of Kailash (corporate drafting).

skills.v: Plaints, written statements, counter-claims, writ petitions (Articles 226 and 227), SLPs, appeals, review petitions, legal notices and replies, replies to show-cause notices, cease-and-desist notices, commercial agreements and arbitration clauses.
SCC Online, Manupatra, SEBI, SAT, NCLT and CCI portals; pinpoint verification against reported judgments.

project.name: Real estate due-diligence engine
project.text: A diligence tool for the Greater Noida property corridor. A deterministic Python rule engine evaluates title and regulatory checks; Tesseract OCR extracts text from records; no language model sits in the decision path, so every conclusion is traceable to a rule.

publication: Practitioner note on Sanjabij Tari v. Kishore S. Borcar: Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act read with Section 223 BNSS.
additional: First-generation advocate, from a family of police and army officers.
Competitive shooter: pre-State qualifier, 25-metre standard pistol.
